title: Split config defaults, schema metadata, env/secret resolution, and migration policy
description: AstrBot's default config file is broad and also feeds WebUI metadata and compatibility behavior. Rust runtime config should separate defaults, schema metadata, version/migration policy, environment variable resolution, and secret redaction before dashboard config editing expands.

files.change: Move schema/version policy away from plain runtime DTO definitions.
Centralize provider key/env placeholder resolution with testable redaction behavior.
Prepare typed metadata that dashboard APIs can consume without hardcoding runtime internals.

criteria: Existing config files and defaults remain compatible.
Provider-specific runtime option schemas stay typed but can expose UI metadata.
Secret/env handling is testable and does not leak sensitive values in errors.
